hero.role: Senior Full-Stack Visual Artist & Software Engineer · 10+ Years

about.bio2: For years, I used my design expertise as a strategic "Business Weapon" — crafting high-impact ads, visual identities, and professional marketing content for my own technical ventures.
about.bio3: After a decade of using design to drive real-world tech success, I'm returning to the freelance world to offer you that same professional edge. I don't just "draw" — I engineer visual experiences. I blend the precision of a Software Engineer with the boundless creativity of an Artist.
about.tagline: I don't follow trends. I create excellence.
about.whyText: Professional quality, engineering-grade precision, and lightning-fast delivery. Let's transform your vision into a digital masterpiece.

projects.title: GLITCH-TECH:THE SHADOW INVASION // Storytelling Spider-Verse
projects.description: Late nights at the local coffee shop take a lethal turn when a routine system update fractures reality. This project explores the transition from the mundane to the digital front-line, where a laptop becomes a gateway to a neon-drenched conflict. Through high-octane comic aesthetics and cinematic paneling, we follow a developer pulled into a "Cyber-Shadow Invasion," forcing an immediate evolution from coder to combat-ready guardian. The boundary between hardware and hero has officially dissolved.
projects.role: Creative Director · Cyberpunk Spider-Verse · Illustrator · AI Art Director · Storyboard Artist

projects.title: COSTA MULTIVERSE // Cyberpunk Spider-Verse
projects.description: Digital life meets multiversal warfare in this high-contrast character study. This project explores the friction between a vibrant, low-poly superhero aesthetic and the gritty underworld of a neon-drenched metropolis. By utilizing explosive comic-book visuals and a kinetic "Spider-Verse" energy, we personify the evolution of a digital creator into a cinematic powerhouse. Every frame is engineered to feel like a high-stakes moment in a digital odyssey where identity is the ultimate weapon. The system is live.
projects.role: Creative Director · Cyberpunk Spider-Verse · Illustrator · AI Art Director

projects.title: GRAND THEFT AUTO VI STYLE // ILLUSTRATION SERIES
projects.description: High-octane visual storytelling meets the sun-drenched grit of Vice City. This series reclaims the iconic Grand Theft Auto aesthetic, injecting a sharp, cinematic edge into character-driven environments. By blending hyper-saturated neon palettes with aggressive linework, the project captures the friction between luxury and the underground. Every frame is built to pulse with the kinetic energy of a mission start, bridging the gap between raw photography and legendary gaming lore. The city is yours.
projects.role: Creative Director · Illustrator · Character Designer · AI Art Director · GTA STYLE

projects.title: MARVEL COMIC // VINTAGE COVER REIMAGINATION
projects.description: This series deconstructs personal identity and reassembles it through the lens of Bronze Age Marvel aesthetics. We explored the intersection of heritage branding and pop culture narrative, utilizing period-accurate halftone patterns, weathered paper textures, and aggressive action-oriented typography. Each frame lives in a curated multiverse where everyday technical tasks are elevated to heroic exploits. It’s an exercise in nostalgic storytelling, blending 1970s Marvel-inspired artistry with modern digital identity. The legacy is re-inked.
projects.role: Creative Director · Marvel Artist · Illustrator · AI Art Director

projects.title: CURRENT REALITY // CYBER-MULTIVERSE DESCENT
projects.description: This series documents the total digital overwrite of the present day. We took raw, everyday captures and forced them through a multiversal filter, collapsing the distance between our current reality and a high-octane, neon-drenched future. By injecting aggressive comic-book kinetics and rain-slicked cyberpunk aesthetics, we transformed the mundane into a cinematic narrative. It’s an exploration of the self, re-rendered for a world where the grid is the only truth. Welcome to the future.
projects.role: Creative Director · Lead Illustrator · Character Designer · AI Art Director

projects.title: NEO-SEOUL CHRONICLES // Cyberpunk Spider-Verse
projects.description: Digital focus meets rain-slicked grit in this exploration of creative transcendence. This narrative sequence bridges the gap between raw, analog sketches and advanced biometric interfaces, all set within a neon-drenched urban sprawl. By utilizing aggressive halftone textures and high-octane kinetic energy, the project visualizes the moment an artist’s vision becomes a functional, high-tech reality. It is a cinematic tribute to the relentless grind of the modern full-stack creative. The system is live.
projects.role: Creative Director · Illustrator · Character Designer · AI Art Director

projects.title: NEO-SEOUL DISTRICT // Cyberpunk Spider-Verse
projects.description: High-stakes digital focus meets a rain-slicked cyberpunk aesthetic. This series reimagines a real-world creative workflow within the neon-drenched grid of a futuristic Neo-Seoul. Utilizing aggressive halftone patterns and cinematic "Spider-Verse" kinetic energy, the project visualizes the intensity of software engineering as a superhero narrative. Every frame pulses with electricity, bridging the gap between raw photography and stylized comic-book maximalism. This is where technical precision meets high-octane visual storytelling. The system is live.
projects.role: Creative Director · Lead Illustrator · AI Art Director · Character Designer

projects.title: MAZEN COSTA // DIGITAL INSIGHT:THE 60-YEAR PERSPECTIVE
projects.description: This personal exploration documents the transition of identity into digital legacy. We captured the contemplative depth of a seasoned creator, integrating 60 years of life experience into a stylized, mature persona. The visual narrative combines precise vector-inspired linework with a dynamic, high-angle 'God's eye' perspective, personifying wisdom and enduring focus. It’s an intimate look at the moment where knowledge becomes technical prowess, proving that creativity knows no age limit. The journey continues.
projects.role: Creative Director · 3D Artist · Character Designer · AI Art Director

projects.title: SKETCHBOOK SESSIONS // THE KINETIC ARCHIVE
projects.description: A deep dive into the raw, ink-heavy world of character development. This project documents the transition from loose conceptual sketches to high-contrast, finished illustrations, pulling heavy influence from urban street culture and the bold linework of classic graphic novels. We explored diverse personas—from tactical urban visionaries to playful caricatures—maintaining a gritty, hand-drawn energy throughout. It’s an exploration of identity and narrative, proving that the strongest stories begin with a single, confident stroke of the pen. The line never lies.
projects.role: Creative Director · Lead Illustrator · Concept Artist · AI Art Director

projects.title: COSTA // HYPER-EXPRESSIVE CHARACTER LAB
projects.description: Character design enters a new dimension of exaggerated realism. We explored the boundary between stylized caricature and high-fidelity 3D modeling to personify the caffeine-fueled creative process. By utilizing a hyper-expressive visual language, the project captures a singular moment of shock and realization, blending soft-touch textures with cinematic lighting. This is an exercise in emotional resonance, where every exaggerated feature serves to amplify the narrative of a modern tech-driven workflow. Digital personality, fully caffeinated.
projects.role: Creative Director · Illustrator · 3D Artist · AI Art Director

projects.title: COSTA UNLOCKER // MOTION CAMPAIGN
projects.description: Technology meets transcendence in this high-octane visual journey. We followed the transformation of a creator into a digital powerhouse, blending low-poly geometry with high-fidelity cinematic lighting. This project explores the friction between the physical and the virtual, utilizing a kinetic energy inspired by modern animation to personify software capability. It’s more than a process—it’s an awakening. Every frame is engineered to feel like a high-stakes moment in a digital odyssey.
projects.role: Creative Director · Motion Artist · AI Art Director
